[{"schema":"private","relname":"mv_book_community_stats","reloptions":null,"definition":" SELECT b.id AS book_id,
    b.title,
    COALESCE(bms.mood_counts, '{}'::jsonb) AS mood_counts,
    COALESCE(bms.pace_percent, '{"fast": 0, "slow": 0, "medium": 0}'::jsonb) AS pace_percent,
    bms.plot_vs_character_avg,
    bms.sample_size AS mood_sample_size,
    count(br.id) FILTER (WHERE br.deleted_at IS NULL) AS review_count,
    round(avg(br.rating) FILTER (WHERE br.deleted_at IS NULL), 2) AS avg_rating,
    round(avg(br.spice_level) FILTER (WHERE br.deleted_at IS NULL), 2) AS avg_spice
   FROM books b
     LEFT JOIN book_mood_stats bms ON bms.book_id = b.id
     LEFT JOIN book_reviews br ON br.book_id = b.id AND br.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY b.id, b.title, bms.mood_counts, bms.pace_percent, bms.plot_vs_character_avg, bms.sample_size;"},{"schema":"public","relname":"v_book_community_stats","reloptions":["security_invoker=true"],"definition":" SELECT book_id,

    avg_spice
   FROM private.mv_book_community_stats;"},{"schema":"public","relname":"v_club_progress_panel","reloptions":["security_invoker=true"],"definition":" SELECT uc.id AS club_id,
    uc.name AS club_name,
    uc.current_book_id,
    b.title AS current_book_title,
    uc.current_season_id,
    current_season.title AS current_season_title,
    uc.current_started_at,
    uc.current_ends_at,
    count(DISTINCT up.user_id) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_readers,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL AND up.status = 'read'::shelf_status) AS chapters_read,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL AND up.status = 'reading'::shelf_status) AS chapters_in_progress,
    round(avg(up.percent) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL), 2) AS avg_percent
   FROM user_clubs uc
     JOIN user_club_members ucm ON ucm.club_id = uc.id
     LEFT JOIN books b ON b.id = uc.current_book_id
     LEFT JOIN seasons current_season ON current_season.id = uc.current_season_id
     LEFT JOIN user_progress up ON up.user_id = ucm.user_id
     LEFT JOIN chapters c ON c.id = up.chapter_id
     LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.id = c.season_id AND s.book_id = uc.current_book_id AND (uc.current_season_id IS NULL OR s.id = uc.current_season_id)
  WHERE uc.current_book_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY uc.id, uc.name, uc.current_book_id, b.title, uc.current_season_id, current_season.title, uc.current_started_at, uc.current_ends_at;"}]
